en: Color multi-view postcard showing modernist seaside hotels and apartment blocks at the Black Sea resort labeled Mangalia Nord – VENUS. One photo includes a hotel with rounded balconies (sign reading Hotel Melodia). The reverse has Romanian layout text, a 40 BANI blue Romanian stamp (POSTA ROMANA) and a circular postmark, price Lei 1,50, and publisher Editura Meridiane.
